SELECT f.*,
b.unit AS stock_unit, b.quantity AS stock_quantity, b.reserved_quantity AS stock_reserved_quantity, b.quantity - b.reserved_quantity AS stock_available_quantity
NULL::text AS stock_unit, NULL::numeric AS stock_quantity, NULL::numeric AS stock_reserved_quantity, NULL::numeric AS stock_available_quantity
FROM filtered f
LEFT JOIN xsy_inventory_balance b ON b.warehouse_id = f.warehouse_id AND b.sku_id = f.sku_id AND b.deleted = FALSE AND f.exception_type = 'SORTING_SHORTAGE'
ORDER BY f.occurred_at DESC, f.exception_type, f.source_row_id DESC
SELECT exception_type, COUNT(*) AS exception_count, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count FROM filtered GROUP BY exception_type ORDER BY exception_type
